gripOrHq.title: Systematic Layoffs
gripOrHq.rulesText: Add two advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

gripOrHq.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

gripOrHq.title: Project Zurich
gripOrHq.rulesText: For every two advancement counters over Project Zurich 's difficulty that are on Project Zurich when you score it, gain 1 at the start of each of your turns.

heapOrArchives.title: Setup!
heapOrArchives.rulesText: When Runner accesses Setup!, it does 2 Net damage, even if it is not installed. Ignore this effect if Runner accesses it from the Archives. If Setup! is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

heapOrArchives.title: Red Herrings
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Runner must pay [5], in addition to any other costs, to steal agendas accessed from this fort, even on the run during which Runner trashes Red Herrings.

heapOrArchives.title: Vapor Ops
heapOrArchives.rulesText:
You may advance Vapor Ops before and after you rez it.
Vapor Ops advancement counter: Gain [1].
A: Move any number of advancement counters from Vapor Ops to another installed card that can be advanced.

scoreArea.title: Project Babylon
scoreArea.rulesText: Score 1 additional agenda point for every two advancement counters over Project Babylon's difficulty that are on Project Babylon when you score it.

discardCards.title: Inside Job
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

discardCards.title: All-Nighter
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run; whether or not that run is successful, you may then make another run.

discardCards.title: Inside Job
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

discardCards.title: Kilroy Was Here
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run on R&D; you may trash, at no cost, any cards you access that were stored in R&D, even if the cards cannot normally be trashed.

rig.title: Hammer
rig.rulesText: [1]: Break wall subroutine. [1]: +1 strength. Whenever you break a wall subroutine with Hammer, lose a total of [2] from stealth cards.
